_doc: Radial-velocity search for the survey target carried as ALMA J153702653-33192492. Frozen so the build makes no network call; proposed destination r27inputs/rv_j1537_r27.json. Every catalogue named in the paper's clause is recorded here with its own query and its own result, so the clause 'no radial velocity in SIMBAD, VizieR or Gaia DR3' is read from a record and not typed. If any 'radial_velocity_kms' below becomes non-null on a refresh (Gaia DR4 is due 2026-12-02), bookkeep_r13.py's B11 fails and the prose must change.

identity.match_basis: products' own t1_ra/t1_dec (pbaudit_v408/pbgeom.json, 53 windows) against Gaia DR3 at ref_epoch 2016.0, propagated by proper motion

identifiers.paper_name_resolves_in_simbad_to: ALMA J153702.653-331924.92 (otype '?', no parallax, no spectral type; 2021A&A...646A..10S) -- a DIFFERENT SIMBAD object, 6.8 arcsec from the star at J2000

vizier_all.query: VizieR all-catalogue cone, 6 arcsec about the J2000 position

why_gaia_dr3_has_none.grvs_estimate_basis: G_RP 14.504 + mean(G_RVS - G_RP) = -0.606 +- 0.073 over 364 Gaia DR3 sources with parallax > 20 mas and G - G_RP in [1.34, 1.38]
why_gaia_dr3_has_none.peers_with_rv: 37 of 253 Gaia DR3 sources with parallax > 20 mas, G in [15.76, 15.96], G - G_RP in [1.33, 1.39]
why_gaia_dr3_has_none.reading: at the faint and cool edge of the DR3 RVS selection, not beyond the magnitude limit
